Toggling this off will prevent the tool from selecting Building assets.
Toggling this off will prevent the tool from selecting Network assets such as roads, tracks, and powerlines.

Toggling this off will prevent the tool from selecting plants that are not trees such as cultivated bushes and potted plants.
Toggling this off will prevent the tool from selecting decals.

Toggling this off will prevent the tool from selecting surfaces.
